## Pull Request

**Description**
A clear and concise description of what this pull request does.

**Related Issue**
Link to the issue that this pull request addresses (e.g., `Fixes #123`).

**Type of Change**
Please delete options that are not relevant.
- Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- Documentation update

**Checklist**
- [ ] My change follows the existing style and conventions of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own change
- [ ] I have commented my work, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added or updated tests/validation that prove my change is effective
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally with my changes (e.g. `npm test` in `skills/easywos-spec/scripts`)
- [ ] I regenerated `skills/combined-spec-summary.yaml` if any leaf spec changed
- [ ] My commits are signed off (DCO): `git commit -s`

**Additional Context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the pull request here.
